notes: Security grade: every scan gets an A-F grade and a score out of 100, with the reason and how it changed since last time - on the dashboard, reports, PDF and weekly summary.
Never scan this device: tick it on any device (printers, medical or industrial equipment) and Wrenscan lists it but never probes it.
Emerging-threat alerts (Home Plus and Business): every morning Wrenscan checks the latest list of flaws attackers are using and tells you the same day if one is on your network.
PDF reports start with an executive summary: the grade, what it means, what was checked and what to fix first. Business plans can add their logo.
Try Home Plus free for 14 days: one click, no card, no account.
Tidier dashboard: shorter lists with 'Show all', 'Jump to' links, and the device list only shows devices on your own network.
